results.title: CamGirl
results.overview: Navy is moments away from undressing in front of hundreds of paying viewers online until a surprise call from her best friend Miranda takes the night in an unexpected direction. What begins as a cam session turns into a different kind of striptease; one that peels back layers far more intimate than clothing.

results.title: Les Rêveurs
results.overview: Elisabeth, an actress, leads writing workshops at Necker Hospital with teenagers experiencing severe psychological distress. Through her interactions with them, she revisits her own story: her institutionalization at age 14. Little by little, the memories resurface. And with them, the discovery of theater, which one day saved her.

results.title: Frozen Hot Boys
results.original_title: แก๊งหิมะเดือด
results.overview: Driven by her personal agenda, a teacher at a juvenile detention center convinces a crew of teenage misfits to enter an snow sculpting contest in Japan.

results.title: Boty: I Am the Sixties
results.overview: Documentary film about pop art sensation Pauline Boty, tracking the artist’s original contribution to British art, her feminism and her unique take on the nascent celebrity culture of the 1960s.  Ahead of her time in so many ways, Boty’s story ends with her tragic early death at 28 in 1966 and the subsequent revival of interest in her work in the last decade.  Packed full of original photographs and art work, the film calls on an array of family, friends, art critics and famous fans to lead us through the Boty story. Contributors include pop art titan Sir Peter Blake, comedian and artist Jim Moir, critic Kate Bryan, best friend and print designer Natalie Gibson MBE, pop singers Corinne Drewery and Tanita Tikaram and TV presenter Ronnie Archer Morgan

results.title: A Very Dirty Christmas
results.overview: When their sister leaves a mysterious voice note before disappearing, two women go undercover to track her down

results.title: Evil Nun
results.overview: When a Catholic youth ministry is invited to spend the night in a vacant Mexican church, they're suddenly trapped by the ghostly apparition of a vengeful nun. Now their only hope is to break the curse before she claims them all, one deadly sin at a time.

results.title: 7.10 Sur rojo
results.overview: Through previously unseen documentary material, testimonies from survivors and reflections from specialists, this documentary deals with the brutal attack perpetrated on October 7, 2023 by the terrorist group Hamas in the south of Israel.

results.title: GIRLS BAND CRY The Movie: Youth Rhapsody
results.original_title: 劇場版総集編 ガールズバンドクライ 【前編】 青春狂走曲
results.overview: After she drops out of school and moves to Tokyo by herself, Nina Iseri meets Momoka Kawaragi, the vocalist of her favourite band, and discovers the allure of music. Together with Subaru Awa, who always hides her true intentions, Tomo Ebizuka, who was ignored by her parents, and Rupa who has no relatives, Nina starts the rock band Togenashi Togeari. The five girls who all have their own worries confront the absurdities of the world and search for their place to belong.

results.title: Espinal
results.overview: Espinal tells the story of one of Puerto Rico's most important athletes who, despite all the difficult circumstances, managed to give his country a great joy, being an Olympic medalist. A story of resilience, love, faith and courage.

results.title: Water Girl
results.overview: Mia has spent her whole life freediving, fishing and gliding through seaweed and rocks. Time has passed, tracing its lines on her body, and shaping the landscapes around her. Loved ones have vanished. Tonight, Mia remembers.

results.title: Kino
results.overview: An observation of daily life from the perspective of a cinema employee together with the imagination and power of cinema.

results.title: The Statement of Randolph Carter
results.overview: In this short, pseudo vintage silent film a man relates a story of what happened to his friend during a visit to an ancient cemetery.

results.title: Daisy
results.overview: A war veteran rescues a tiny creature that he smuggles back to the states only to realize it is not what he thought it was. It must eat and he continues to feed it by committing horrific crimes that ultimately catch up with him and the creature,

results.title: My Date with a Vampire
results.overview: An exorcist heir and an immortal from the Blood Tribe cross paths during an investigation, uncovering past-life entanglements while uniting to stop a powerful villain’s plan to take over the world.

results.title: Cleanse
results.overview: A paranoid germophobe becomes convinced he's been infected by a deadly virus. As his anxiety to be clean spirals out of control, his desperate attempts to rid himself of the infection take a tragic turn.

results.title: Yakushima's Illusion
results.overview: Corry, a French coordinator of pediatric heart transplants is sent to Japan where organ donation remains taboo. As she fights to save a young boy, her partner Jin, a photographer from Yakushima, suddenly vanishes.

results.title: Apus Apus
results.overview: Guadalupe, Silberius de Ura, and Sampe live in three different villages, each with very different personal backgrounds. Yet they share something: it is in the landscapes they inhabit that they find the motivation and inspiration guiding their respective journeys.

results.title: Holy Rollers
results.overview: A grumpy, cynical priest and his young, naïve apprentice work out of a beat-up van. Called to perform an exorcism, they find the man's wife more concerned about her image and the neighbours' reactions. Things don't go as planned...

results.title: Westgate
results.overview: Over the course of one day, a single mother in Melbourne’s working-class west must draw on all of her resources as she confronts the ghosts of her past.

results.title: Locos de Amor, Mi Primer Amor
results.original_title: Locos de Amor, Mi Primer Amor
results.overview: It’s the final school year, and with it comes the long-awaited graduation trip to Uruguay, the last chance for everyone to be together before each one goes their own way. The story follows six teenage friends as they experience the first sparks of love and heartbreak, all while expressing a passion for music, tropical vibes, and Latin culture.
